# vcp_dns_record_set (Resource)

Manages a DNS record set (RRset) — all records sharing one `name` and `type`. Per DNS/PowerDNS semantics the `ttl` is shared across the whole set; the individual values are the rdata. Changing `domain`, `name` or `type` forces a new record set.

`name` must be a full FQDN inside the zone (either the zone itself or a subdomain of `domain`); relative names and `@` are not supported. Names are canonicalized to a lowercase, trailing-dot FQDN. For `SRV`, encode the service and protocol in the name as `_service._proto.zone.` (e.g. `_sip._tcp.example.com.`) — the DNS-standard form.

**Note:** each `(domain, name, type)` must be managed by exactly one `vcp_dns_record_set`; creating a set that already exists (e.g. made outside Terraform) fails with an import hint. `ttl` is sticky: once set it is not reset to the API default by removing it from the config. `TXT` values are stored in presentation form (wrapped in quotes) by the backend; very long (>255-byte) TXT strings may not round-trip cleanly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A record set (RRset) shares a single TTL across all its values. Names are
# FQDNs; the trailing dot is added automatically.
resource "vcp_dns_record_set" "www" {
  domain = vcp_dns_domain.example.name
  name   = "www.example.com"
  type   = "A"
  ttl    = "1h"
  values = [
    { ip = "10.0.0.1" },
    { ip = "10.0.0.2" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Zone this record set belongs to, e.g. `example.com.`. Case and the trailing dot are not significant. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Record set name (FQDN), e.g. `www.example.com.`. Case and the trailing dot are not significant. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `type` (String) Record type. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `values` (Attributes Set) Values (rdata) of the record set. At least one is required. Fields used depend on `type`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--values))

### Optional

- `ttl` (String) TTL shared by the whole record set. One of: 1s, 5s, 30s, 1m, 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 6h, 12h, 1d. If omitted, the API default is used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Record set identifier (`domain/name/type`).

<a id="nestedatt--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `values`

Optional:

- `canonical_name` (String) Canonical name (CNAME).
- `ip` (String) IPv4/IPv6 address (A/AAAA).
- `mail_host` (String) Mail host (MX).
- `name_server_host` (String) Name server host (NS).
- `port` (Number) Port (SRV), 0-65535.
- `priority` (Number) Priority (MX/SRV), 0-65535.
- `target` (String) Target (SRV).
- `text` (String) Text (TXT).
- `weight` (Number) Weight (SRV), 0-65535.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# DNS record sets can be imported as 'domain/name/type'.
terraform import vcp_dns_record_set.example example.com/www.example.com/A
```
